feeds.title: The Inspired Room
feeds.description: Get helpful tips across design, homemaking, decor tips, and organization for every room of the house. The Inspired Room is created by Melissa Michaels who loves to write about finding contentment at home. The Inspired Room is one of the top design blogs that offer Guides, Books, and other resources on Home Decor.

feeds.title: My Sweet Savannah
feeds.description: My name is Melaine Thompson and I have a passion for DIY projects and interior design. I created this blog to help spread my passion for design, and hopefully, give some of you some ideas on creating the home of your dreams.

feeds.title: Board & Vellum Blog
feeds.description: From answering your questions about design, projects, and design process, to sharing how we work, our blog is an approachable and helpful resource. Based on Capitol Hill in Seattle, Board & Vellum is a multidisciplinary design firm practicing architecture, interior design, and landscape architecture for residential, commercial, and civic projects.

feeds.title: Pulp Design Studios Blog
feeds.description: Pulp Design Studios is a boutique national interior design firm, specializing in residential, hospitality, commercial, and multi-family design, with studios in Dallas Seattle. Their blog is your daily guide to interior design & splendid living.

feeds.title: The Phinery Blog
feeds.description: Learn more about our interior design services or shop our locally made, highly curated Seattle home store. At The Phinery, we offer interior design services including projects of all sizes such as kitchen and bath remodels, furnishings and decor, on-site styling, and more.

feeds.title: Miller Interior Design Blog
feeds.description: Explore stories from The Journal, Keith Miller's interior design blog, and stay up to date on the latest trends, colors, design considerations, and more. Miller Interior Design researches and develops authentic personal surroundings that celebrate your unique identity and purpose.

feeds.title: Seriously Happy Homes Blog
feeds.description: At Seriously Happy Homes we're all about making your space even happier. We offer DIY Quick-Action Design Sessions & Interior Design services in Seattle, WA. Find design tips and resources on the Seriously Happy Homes Blog.

feeds.title: Cassandra LaValle
feeds.description: For nearly 20 years Cassandra LaValle has spent her career crafting personal environments and experiences through events, interiors, and merchandising. Find her exclusive styling tips, interior & entertaining inspiration, updates on events and offerings, and all her favorite discoveries for the home.

feeds.title: K. Peterson Design Blog
feeds.description: K. Peterson Design is a Bellevue Interior Design Studio specializing in custom new builds and full-scale remodels, offering full-service residential interior design & decorating services in the Greater Seattle Area. Stay up to date with the latest design trends, home decor, KPD picks, and more.

feeds.title: Seattle Staged to Sell & Design Blog
feeds.description: Find out about our staging projects and our design and real estate advice. Seattle Staged to Sell is a boutique-style home staging company. Since 2005, we have been renowned for our incomparable attention to detail regardless of project size. Creating custom designs for each home and putting our clients first are at the heart of what we do.

feeds.title: KP Spaces Blog
feeds.description: At KP Spaces, we believe wholeheartedly in the transformative power of design. From renovations to furniture design, we custom-tailor projects that fit your specific needs. We are dedicated to providing a luxury experience for every client. Find interior design tips and tricks on KP Spaces Blogs.

feeds.title: A Layered Life Blog
feeds.description: A Layered Life is a blog written by Lauren L Caron, a creative consultant, documenting inspiration, the design evolution of Lauren's Seattle Craftsman and Brooklyn Pied a Terre, travel, and experiences.

feeds.title: Tandon Interiors Blog
feeds.description: Tandon Interiors is a full-service residential interior design studio in Seattle, WA. Our mission is to create homes that feel timeless and approachable while meeting the demands of family life. Explore our blogs for the newest project information, design tips, and tricks.

feeds.title: Elegant Simplicity Blog
feeds.description: Covers styling, design, decluttering and organizing resources for clients as well as interior design, and home organizing enthusiasts. Elegant Simplicity shares ideas on decorating, organizing trends, interior design how-tos, project stories, and more.
